subtitles.sun: The wider tone of this period

summaries.moon: The phase shows where the cycle is, while the Moon sign shows how that tone is expressed.
summaries.lunar: This card is purely calendar-based: it shows your distance to the full moon, not the mood of the day.
summaries.planet: The day ruler gives a broad rhythm, but it does not replace your horoscope or daily card.
summaries.sun: The Sun here shows a seasonal background, not just a one-day mood.
summaries.element: The element shows the reaction style of the day: emotional, mental, practical, or impulsive.
summaries.streak: This is not an astrology card. It shows how you are actually engaging with the app today.
summaries.retro: This card is not about fear. It shows which themes of the day need more attention.

compatibilityPage.title: Compatibility
compatibilityPage.subtitle: A clearer sign-level reading for two people.
compatibilityPage.heroText: Pick your sign and the other person to see the basic emotional tone, pace, and pressure points in this match.
compatibilityPage.emptyText: Select both signs to see a grounded overview of what flows easily, where friction tends to appear, and what helps this pair work better.

scope.title: What this reading is
scope.text: This is a broad sun-sign overview. It uses element and modality only, so it should guide reflection, not act like a final verdict.

easy.title: Easy flow
easy.summary: This pair usually has a natural bridge. The connection tends to move with less resistance when both people stay present.

mixed.title: Mixed but workable
mixed.summary: There is real potential here, but the pair works better when expectations and pace are made explicit.

intentional.title: Needs intention
intentional.summary: This match can still work, but it asks for clearer communication, more patience, and less assumption.

strengths.air_air: Fast mental chemistry and easy conversation create momentum quickly.
strengths.air_earth: Ideas meet structure, so this pair can turn thoughts into something tangible.
strengths.air_fire: There is spark, movement, and strong inspiration between these two signs.
strengths.air_water: This pair brings thought and feeling together when both sides stay patient.
strengths.earth_earth: Consistency and trust grow naturally here and become a strong base.
strengths.earth_fire: One brings drive, the other turns it into real-world progress.
strengths.earth_water: Care and stability support each other well in this match.
strengths.fire_fire: High energy and mutual courage make this pair feel alive fast.
strengths.fire_water: Intensity and sensitivity create depth when the tone stays gentle.
strengths.water_water: This is naturally intuitive, emotionally rich, and deeply receptive.

warnings.cardinal_cardinal: Both people want to lead. Decisions work better when control is shared early.
warnings.cardinal_fixed: One pushes forward while the other stabilizes. Pace matters more than intensity here.
warnings.cardinal_mutable: This pair moves easily, but direction has to stay clear or energy scatters.
warnings.fixed_fixed: Strong loyalty is here, but stubborn moments can freeze the connection.
warnings.fixed_mutable: Different pace is the main tension: one protects, the other shifts.
warnings.mutable_mutable: There is flexibility and ease, but the pair needs structure to stay grounded.

approaches.easy: Lean into what already works, but keep the connection intentional so ease does not become autopilot.
approaches.mixed: This pair works best when expectations are named clearly and both sides adjust pace instead of assuming.
approaches.intentional: Slow the dynamic down, name the difference early, and treat clarity as part of care instead of conflict.

elementTexts.air_air: Air with air is mental spark and constant exchange. Stay grounded to keep depth.
elementTexts.air_earth: Ideas meet structure. Build a shared plan to avoid drifting apart.
elementTexts.air_fire: Fire needs air, air loves fire. The pair moves quickly and inspires action.
elementTexts.air_water: Thought meets feeling. Translate emotions into words for harmony.
elementTexts.earth_earth: Earth with earth builds trust and stability. Give it time and it grows strong.
elementTexts.earth_fire: Heat meets patience. When aligned, this duo turns desire into results.
elementTexts.earth_water: Earth anchors water, water softens earth. This is steady and nurturing.
elementTexts.fire_fire: Two fires amplify momentum: bold, bright, and fast. Keep rhythm to avoid burnout.
elementTexts.fire_water: Steam and contrast: passion meets sensitivity. Balance pace and tone.
elementTexts.water_water: Water with water is deep empathy and intuition. Boundaries keep it healthy.

insights.air_air: Name one shared idea and act on it within 48 hours.
insights.air_earth: Write the plan down so inspiration meets structure.
insights.air_fire: Keep the pace exciting, but pause to listen.
insights.earth_earth: Invest in routine; it becomes your strength.
insights.earth_fire: Give each other room to lead at times.
insights.earth_water: Stability plus care is the winning formula.
insights.fire_fire: Channel energy into a shared goal.
insights.fire_water: Respect sensitivity and keep the tone gentle.
insights.water_water: Boundaries protect the depth you share.

modalityTexts.cardinal_cardinal: Two initiators: high drive and fast starts. Align goals early so momentum does not turn into competition.
modalityTexts.fixed_fixed: Steady and loyal, but stubborn. Patience and respect keep it balanced.
modalityTexts.mutable_mutable: Flexible and curious. Needs structure to avoid drifting.
modalityTexts.cardinal_fixed: Starter meets keeper. Pace the relationship and share control.
modalityTexts.cardinal_mutable: Movement and adaptability. Works well with clear direction.
modalityTexts.fixed_mutable: Stability meets change. Build trust while allowing growth.

details.modelTitle: This page gives a sign-level overview, not a personal synastry chart.
details.modelText: The reading compares two sun signs through element chemistry and modality pace. That makes it useful for broad patterns, but not specific enough for highly personal claims.

useList.element: How the two elements tend to interact
useList.modality: How the two signs usually move, start, or adapt

missList.moon: Moon sign and emotional chart details
missList.birthTime: Birth time and exact chart timing

details.transparencyText: This reading is intentionally broad. It should help the user reflect on a relationship dynamic, not believe the app can define the whole relationship from two birthdays alone.
